description: This file defines the ProductEntity class, which extends the Product class and implements Serializable; it adds additional product-specific properties such as price, quantity, SKU, dimensions, weight, rating, and availability details used in the web application's catalog.

classes.name: ProductEntity
classes.description: Represents a product with various attributes such as price, quantity, SKU, dimensions, weight, rating, and availability status, used within the web application's catalog module.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the product's price as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the product's price.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the available quantity of the product.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the available quantity of the product.

methods.name: getSku
methods.description: Returns the SKU identifier of the product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU identifier of the product.

methods.name: isProductShipeable
methods.description: Checks if the product is shippable.

methods.name: setProductShipeable
methods.description: Sets whether the product is shippable.

methods.name: isProductIsFree
methods.description: Checks if the product is free.

methods.name: setProductIsFree
methods.description: Sets whether the product is free.

methods.name: getProductLength
methods.description: Returns the length dimension of the product.

methods.name: setProductLength
methods.description: Sets the length dimension of the product.

methods.name: getProductWidth
methods.description: Returns the width dimension of the product.

methods.name: setProductWidth
methods.description: Sets the width dimension of the product.

methods.name: getProductHeight
methods.description: Returns the height dimension of the product.

methods.name: setProductHeight
methods.description: Sets the height dimension of the product.

methods.name: getProductWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the product.

methods.name: setProductWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the product.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the product.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the product.

methods.name: setQuantityOrderMaximum
methods.description: Sets the maximum order quantity allowed.

methods.name: getQuantityOrderMaximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum order quantity.

methods.name: setProductVirtual
methods.description: Sets whether the product is virtual.

methods.name: isProductVirtual
methods.description: Checks if the product is virtual.

methods.name: setAvailable
methods.description: Sets the availability status of the product.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether the product is available.

methods.name: setDateAvailable
methods.description: Sets the date when the product becomes available.

methods.name: getDateAvailable
methods.description: Returns the availability date of the product.

methods.name: setQuantityOrderMinimum
methods.description: Sets the minimum order quantity.

methods.name: getQuantityOrderMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum order quantity.

methods.name: setRatingCount
methods.description: Sets the number of ratings.

methods.name: getRatingCount
methods.description: Returns the number of ratings.

methods.name: setRating
methods.description: Sets the rating value.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Returns the product's rating.
